dc:description: Generated by tools/csvw/generate_csvw.py from tools/csvw/*-schema.json — do not hand-edit, regenerate instead.

columns.name: code
columns.dc:description: Conversation code — matches the <code>.vert.tsv filename.

columns.name: type
columns.dc:description: Conversation type. Not a closed set across modules — e.g. KIPasti has finer-grained subtypes like 'free-conversation:meal'.

columns.name: participants
columns.dc:description: Semicolon-separated list of participant codes.

columns.name: collection-point
columns.dc:description: Module-specific set of site codes (e.g. BO, TO).

columns.name: code
columns.dc:description: Participant code — matches `speaker` values in vert.tsv.

columns.name: gender
columns.dc:description: Commonly F|M, not enforced as a hard constraint.

columns.name: conversations
columns.dc:description: Semicolon-separated list of conversation codes this participant appears in.

columns.name: age-range
columns.dc:description: 5-year bucket, e.g. 21-25.

columns.name: token_id
columns.dc:description: TU_ID-TOKEN_IDX, assigned at creation. Stable and creation-order — not guaranteed monotonic within a TU after a split/add (use `id` for true order, where present).

columns.name: speaker
columns.dc:description: Tier ID / participant code.

columns.name: tu_id
columns.dc:description: Transcription unit id, 0-based.

columns.name: id
columns.dc:description: Token's true 0-based position within its TU. Recomputed from row order on every patch — always monotonic, unlike token_id.

columns.name: span
columns.dc:description: Raw enriched span (character slice of the original annotation).

columns.name: form
columns.dc:description: Normalized form: lowercase, no prolongations, no punctuation.

columns.name: lemma
columns.dc:description: Filled by the lemmatization step.

columns.name: upos
columns.dc:description: Universal POS tag. Filled by the lemmatization step.

columns.name: type
columns.dc:description: Token type flag (tools/dataflags.py:tokentype). Current code emits linguistic|shortpause|nonverbalbehavior|error|warning|unknown|anonymized, but this is not enforced as a hard constraint — the code enum has drifted before (see `code_variation` below) and existing files may lag it.

columns.name: code_variation
columns.dc:description: All variation features of the token, pipe-separated Key=Value: `ContainsVariation=Yes|No` (unit level, repeated on every token row of the unit; always present), `Code=Other|Unsure|Underspecified`, `Language=<ISO code|NO_ISO_CODE>`, `Nonce=Yes`. Replaces the old `variation` column (a single label none|yes|unspecified|all|some, later a feature list with `Variety=Other|Unassignable|Unsure`); the current tools refuse to read the old format.

columns.name: jefferson_feats
columns.dc:description: Pipe-separated: Intonation=X, Interrupted=Yes, Truncated=Yes, Reduced=Yes, ProsodicLink=Yes, SpaceAfter=No, PauseAfter=Yes, Anonymized=Yes, Volume=X, Syllables=N. (Variation features — Code, Language, Nonce — are in the `code_variation` column.)

columns.name: align
columns.dc:description: Begin=X / End=X / Begin=X|End=X for the first/last token of a TU.

columns.name: prolongations
columns.dc:description: e.g. 3x2,7x1 (char_pos x length pairs).

columns.name: guesses
columns.dc:description: 0-3(0),... — genuine 'hard to understand' spans only; see PIPELINE.md for the reduction_words whitelist interaction.
